gate: Every seed: one whole-pose min-cost UNION candidate must strictly lower both full-population T/R medians versus paired R0_ONLY min-cost whole-pose oracle; both P90 <=1.05 and failure count no larger. All three must pass before any learned ranker fit.
finite_scale: R0 old-GEO eligible TRAIN medians must be finite and positive; else stop.
failures: Both T and R +infinity for no usable pose; retain all eligible TRAIN rows in gates.
target_scope: Only eligible proper-rigid declared-C2 TRAIN candidate quality is scored. All original5120 source images stay in frozen feature/pose pool. No VAL quality or real GT quality before later dedicated locks.
inference_ties: Exact learned score ties: fixed R0 preference then hypothesis name. No GT/Pareto at inference.
interpretation: Failure rejects this cost-oracle design, not all possible union selectors. Passing is opportunity only, not learnability or real-data improvement.

next_fit_plan.shared_normalization: R0 eligible TRAIN valid candidates only
next_fit_plan.architecture: one shared linear94 scalar score per pose; no expert ID/image features
next_fit_plan.real_route_prerequisite: After six frozen fits, all seeds must pass dedicated source VAL gate fixed before fitting.
